scenario: v1 exact math built-in set per LEXP.12.6 — abs/min/max/sqrt/round + integer pow. ln/exp and non-integer pow are transcendental and reserved for v2. Pin: every wired exact arithmetic builtin (abs/sqrt/round/pow/min/max) lowers.
rules_ds:
from math import sqrt, pow

schema Sample scope logical:
    v: Float key

rule r:
    Sample s where abs(s.v) < sqrt(round(s.v)) + pow(s.v, 2) and max(s.v, 1.0) > min(s.v, 0.0)
->
    log info "x"
